---
title: "4Demon Pilot Database"
subtitle: "A pilot study to evaluate the database structure using the 4Demon data"
---

This site presents the initial version of the database design and its potential applications using the publicly available [4Demon](https://www.vliz.be/projects/4demon/index.htm) dataset.

## Source Data

-  [Four Decades of Belgian Marine Monitoring (4Demon)](https://www.vliz.be/projects/4demon/index.htm)

### Count of Sediment Sites
The table below summarizes the number of sediment sites collected across five projects between 1978 and 2015.

{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false

aq = require("arquero")

// --- Query: long format counts per cruise type, year, and element ---
counts_long = db.query(`
    SELECT project,
           CAST(CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) AS year,
           UPPER(SUBSTR(parameter_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(parameter_name, 2)) AS parameter_name,
           count(*) AS count
    FROM sediment s1
    JOIN sample s2 ON s2.sample_id = s1.sample_id
    JOIN station s3 ON s3.station_id = s2.station_id
    JOIN project p1 ON p1.project_id = s2.project_id
    JOIN parameter p2 ON p2.parameter = s1.parameter
    WHERE s1.parameter in ('CU', 'ZN')
    GROUP BY project, year, parameter_name
`)

// --- Pivot to wide format using Arquero ---
elements_wide = ["Copper", "Zinc"]

counts_wide = aq.from(counts_long)
  .groupby("project", "year")
  .pivot("parameter_name", "count")
  .orderby("project", "year")
  .rename({ project: "Project", year: "Year" })
  .objects()
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(counts_wide, {
  columns: ["Project", "Year", ...elements_wide],
  layout: "auto",
  rows: 20
})
```

## Database Design and Creation

After creating the ER (Entity–Relationship) diagram, the tables were implemented in a single SQLite file containing 10 tables. All required data were extracted from the 4Demon export file and imported into the corresponding tables.

- See the [DB Schema (Full)](./db-schema.qmd) page for details of the full database architecture.
- See the [Data Preparation](./data-preparation.qmd) page for the data preparation process used prior to importing the ICES-DOME dataset.
- See the [DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd) page for the common multi-source schema.


## Geospatial Analysis

To facilitate efficient core and sample selection, distances to the nearest coastline were calculated for the 4Demon data. In addition, the nearest country and municipality, as well as the sea and ocean names, were identified based on the core locations.

- See the [Distance Calculation](./distance-to-coast.qmd) page for the methods and results of calculating the distance to the nearest coastline.
- See the [Location Names](./location-names.qmd) page for the estimation of location names from geographic coordinates.
- See the [Interactive Map](./distance-interactive-map.qmd) page for an interactive visualization of site locations with meta-information.

## Data Export

Data can be exported for both exploration and submission purposes.

- See the [Export to Tabular File](./data-export.qmd) page for a description of a single tabular file format (`.tsv.gz`) that is extracted and merged from all database tables for data exploration.
- See the [EFSA Format v1](./efsa-format.qmd) and [EFSA Format v2](./efsa-format-v2.qmd) pages for descriptions of the EFSA submission file structures.
- See the [EFSA Submission v1](./efsa-submission.qmd) and [EFSA Submission v2](./efsa-submission-v2.qmd) pages for the mapping between the database fields and the EFSA submission formats.
